rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a piece of land projecting into water.

example.english: This peninsula is surrounded by the sea on three sides, and the scenery is beautiful.
example.traditional: 呢個半島三面環海，風景好靚。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bun3 dou2 saam1 min6 waan4 hoi2 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3
